note: S12-0 drift-corpus SCAFFOLD. Per spec 2026-08-10-s12 §10, S12-0 ships the drift-corpus scaffold: the mutation engine (benchmarks/scrape-quality/drift.ts), this manifest schema, and the validator. It does NOT ship recorded recipes, because a recipe entry requires a recorded StructuredTarget and column set, which need the portable recipe format (S12-2) and the replay path (S12-4). `npm run bench:scrape:drift` therefore reports a shortfall of 15 recipes / 60 cases BY DESIGN, and states in numbers that §8-B's <=0.02 silent-wrong gate is not expressible at 0 cases. Populating this file is S12-4's exit criterion, not S12-0's. Variants are generated by mutating the frozen C0 fixture HTML (fixtures/html) through the five §3.4 mutation classes, so cases are derived from real producer output rather than hand-built literals.
